purpose: Per-session execution goal. Copy this file to goal.json at session start, set the current goal, and keep graders/validation/agent routing current when files or commands change.
goal: <one concrete session goal that moves the GOAL.md product objective forward>

deterministic_graders.name: node_syntax
deterministic_graders.proves: JavaScript entrypoints and grader scripts parse.

deterministic_graders.name: mvp_backend_contract
deterministic_graders.proves: Auth-gated discovery, persisted profile/placement, placement action, feedback, and cross-user isolation work locally.

deterministic_graders.name: release_static_config
deterministic_graders.proves: TestFlight-critical bundle id, entitlements, API base URL, Render env, and privacy-policy files are configured.

deterministic_graders.name: goal_contract
deterministic_graders.proves: goal.json and goal.template.json contain the current grader, validation, rubric, and agent routing contract.

deterministic_graders.name: repo_docs_lint
deterministic_graders.proves: Repo docs follow the local workflow documentation contract.

deterministic_graders.name: local_simulator_validation
deterministic_graders.proves: XcodeGen project builds, installs, launches fresh auth gate, then enters the DEBUG signed-in Talk/Circles/Profile app through backend dev auth.

preferred_agent.name: validation-release
preferred_agent.use_when: Simulator or build verification is read-heavy, screenshot-based, or likely to produce long logs.

checks: Fresh install shows Sign in with Apple gate, not old prototype tabs.
After sign-in, tabs are Talk, Circles, Profile.
Talk can start Realtime voice through the authenticated backend path.
Stopping voice creates placement UI without mock fallback.
Circles accept/swap/defer visibly round-trips through backend state.
Profile edit and feedback paths are visible and retryable.

subagents.default_policy: Do not create new agents unless repeated work is not already owned by an existing project agent.

allowed.name: validation-release
can_do: summarize failing assertions and likely owner files
cannot_do: edit files unless the main thread assigns a bounded patch

allowed.name: native-app
can_do: bounded SwiftUI/native project fixes after deterministic failure evidence
cannot_do: replace the native project strategy without approval

allowed.name: backend-authority
can_do: bounded backend auth, persistence, or API contract fixes after deterministic failure evidence

completion_commit.when: After all required deterministic and simulator/device validation passes, and before marking the session goal complete.
must_include: all implementation, validation, doc, and stale-cleanup files changed for the session

done_criteria: Real Apple sign-in is configured and verified.
Deployed HTTPS API uses Render plus Neon/Postgres or an explicitly accepted replacement.
A signed-in tester completes voice onboarding through persisted placement, profile edit, placement action, and feedback on simulator or device.
`npm run verify:external-preflight` passes with real external evidence recorded.
No stale docs or config describe prototype tabs, prototype bundle id, no auth, or SQLite as the production path.
Validated session changes are committed with the session's goal.json before the goal is marked complete.
